lines: In 1904, a woman named Lizzie Magie patented a board game.
It was built to prove one thing. Landlords get rich, and everyone else goes broke.
About thirty years later, it became Monopoly.
So we built it in code, and let a computer play.
And the busiest square on the board? It isn't Go.
One color set won half of all the games it played.
The most expensive set on the board won only seventeen percent.
By the end of this video, you'll know exactly which set to fight for.
